title: Missing zero-amount check in claim()
description: The claim() function does not check whether the user has any rewards to claim before executing the transfer. This allows users to call claim() even when they have zero rewards, wasting gas and emitting misleading events for zero-value claims.
impact: Minor gas waste and potential for misleading event emissions. Users may call claim() expecting rewards and pay gas for a no-op transaction. Does not result in fund loss.
attackPath: User calls claim() with zero pending rewards
Gas is wasted on zero-value transfer
Events may be emitted for zero-value claim
recommendation: Add a require statement to check that the pending reward amount is greater than zero before processing the claim: `require(pendingReward > 0, "No rewards to claim")`.
